name: Deadly Spark
text:
Aspect air

Activate 2 command, Interact

---
Effect A spark flashes out from the relic toward a creature within 20 feet. This spark deals 1+max(0,floor((@actor.level -2/4)))d12 electricity damage (basic Reflex save save). The damage increases by 1d12 at 6th level and by another 1d12 every 4 levels thereafter.
